Original blank IRS form visibly identifies Form4868 and automatic extension; frozen reference matches.
cases.diagnosis: Pure numeric4868 is not an exact-code identifier under existing patterns, and statistical lexical evidence requires at least two matched tokens. OCR keyword ranking finds the target but fusion ignores this single numeric match. FP32 improves visual rank without fixing this gating limitation.

cases.observation: Original source is an English Operations Capacity Report with customer/date/quantity and section percentages; frozen family describes it.
cases.diagnosis: All20 known Arabic-query targets are absent from the FP32 candidate pool despite available English OCR and non-truncated passage coverage. This is a candidate retrieval weakness, so downstream reranking cannot recover them. The English/French translations retrieve targets. Cross-language representation and conservative OCR fusion need independent evaluation; translation-oracle gains are not a deployed translator.

cases.observation: Original French FileZilla FTP window shows local and remote file lists; matches the frozen reference.
cases.diagnosis: Target remains in the visual candidate pool but ranks lower with FP32, dropping below top10. Unchanged OCR channels do not retrieve it for the Arabic transliteration query. This is an observed visual-ranking regression; no ground truth was changed.

inspected_cases.diagnosis: Both policies share source pixels, metadata, OCR and E5. Only the SigLIP2 image/query precision differs. These recoveries are not caused by different source coverage or OCR. Quantization/export choices versus INT8 runtime kernels are not isolated.

timing_limitations: Sequential cold requests on a 16 GiB battery-powered Mac with active paging observed during FP32. Descriptive timings; do not attribute all timing variation to precision. RSS samples may miss spikes or count shared pages twice.
judgment_limitations: 357 previously inspected queries in 119 correlated families, 119 each en/fr/ar. Unknown candidates are not negatives. Additional 175 images have no invented relevance or provenance. This is not directly comparable to the older 2052-image cohort.
